servinfo.title: Inspection of High Beam Assist Function

item.ptxt: If any malfunction is found during high beam assist inspection, check DTC.
Dual sensor brake support system may not work under certain condition. For the specific information, refer to Precautions for Dual Sensor Brake Support System:Dual Sensor Brake Support .

servinfosub.title: High Beam Assist Indicator Light Function

attention3.ptxt: Auto-on headlight system does not operate under well lighted condition. To activate the system in the lighted condition, cover auto-on headlight sensor with shop cloth or the like.

s1.ptxt: Check that high beam assist indicator light (1) turns ON when all of the following conditions are satisfied.

item.ptxt: Auto-on head light system: In operation
Headlight beam is kept high under dark condition controlled by high beam assist function. Inspect the high beam assist function in well lighted place.
Auto-on headlight system does not operate under well lighted condition. To activate the system in the lighted condition, cover auto-on headlight sensor with shop cloth or the like.

s1.ptxt: Check normal switching function between low beam and high beam by manual operation of lighting and turn signal switch.
Check that all of the following conditions are satisfied.

item.ptxt: Auto-on head light system: In operation

s1.ptxt: Connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1) with ignition “OFF”.
Select “High Beam Assist” under “Active Test” mode in “Dual Sensor Brake Support”.
Check that all of the following conditions are satisfied.

item.ptxt: Gear shift lever (M/T model): Other than neutral and reverse position
Select lever (A/T model): Other than “P” and “R” range
Auto-on head light system: In operation

s1.ptxt: Check the system changes the headlight from low beam to high beam automatically a few seconds after covering dual sensor brake support control module with shop cloth (1) or the like.
Check the system changes the headlight from high beam to low beam automatically a few seconds after removing shop cloth from dual sensor brake support control module.
